profile.headline: Web Designer & Application Developer
profile.summary: I graduated from Millersville University in the spring of 2016 with a BA in Graphic & Interactive Design. I've been developing websites with HTML and CSS since my junior year of high school. I knew I wanted to learn more code, so I joined a training program after college where I learned Java, SQL, Angular, Javascript, and more. I enjoy using my skills as a designer and developer to bring quality graphic and web design and development to people who need it.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer II
positions.description: Develop and maintain mobile-friendly web applications.

positions.title: Contractor - Developer for Penske Truck Leasing
Customer Service Representative
positions.description: My responsibilities include stocking, working register, assisting customers, and organizing aisles.

positions.title: Email Marketing Developer
positions.description: I develop and send HTML emails for companies across the US.

positions.title: Marketing and Design Intern
positions.description: I worked as the graphic design intern for the dining services on campus. My responsibilities included creating menus, signs, and advertisements for the dining halls and retail stores on campus.

volunteerExperiences.description: I am the president and founder of Trans Minors Rights. We are an organization that aims to help transgender youth with legal rights to their own healthcare. I am in charge of communicating with other organizations and individuals to rally them to our cause. I also create all of the branding materials and maintain the website (transminorsrights.org). We have weekly meetings where my team updates me and I delegate tasks to keep us moving forward.
I raised chickens for a year and showed them at a local fair. I also volunteered for a few summers doing landscaping and other community activities.

organizations.name: Dreamers // Doers
organizations.description: Member of a highly curated national club for entrepreneurial women.

organizations.name: Silencing the Hate (University Club)
organizations.description: I was vice president of STH during my junior year (fall 2014 - spring 2015) and president during my senior year (fall 2015 - spring 2016).
